Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident and my knee, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. We'll keep it to the accident. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Katy, Texas. I was moving over one lane to get to the exit ramp when another vehicle
came up alongside me and we scraped sides.
Q: What were you doing right before the contact?
A: I had checked my mirror and saw the lane looked clear. I signaled and started to move over. I felt a bump and
heard metal scraping.
Q: Did the other driver say anything or stop?
A: They slowed down, then kept going for a bit before pulling onto the shoulder. We both ended up stopped there.
Q: Were you hurt at the scene?
A: My knee hit the steering column when the car jolted. It hurt right away, but I didn't think it was serious at first.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since then?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day and then saw an orthopedic provider a few days later. They mentioned
possible ligament strain and ordered imaging.
Q: Are you still having symptoms?
A: Yes. Stairs are difficult, and my knee swells by the end of the day. I've been using a brace and taking it easy at
work.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Only that I was trying to be careful. I'd like the claim handled so I can get my treatment covered.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thanks.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "reason": one short sentence.
